phase: Phase 37 — Dynamic Mission Intent & Runtime Goal Editing

verified_invariants.name: Monotonic Intent Versioning
verified_invariants.statement: v_intent(t+1) = v_intent(t) + 1 on every applied delta. Reversions do not decrement counters.

verified_invariants.name: Monotonic Plan Versioning
verified_invariants.statement: v_plan(t+1) = v_plan(t) + 1 whenever DAG topology, task ordering, or task parameters change.

verified_invariants.name: Strict DAG Topological Validity
verified_invariants.statement: Graph G=(V,E) remains a strict directed acyclic graph post-replan, validated via Kahn's algorithm.

verified_invariants.name: Non-Destructive Rollback & Progress Preservation
verified_invariants.statement: Completed tasks are never erased, reverted, or discarded; necessary adjustments schedule compensation tasks.

verified_invariants.name: Evidence Invalidation & Zero False Success
verified_invariants.statement: Evidence tied to superseded requirements transitions to SUPERSEDED / REVALIDATION_REQUIRED immediately upon delta commit.

verified_invariants.name: Requirement Lifecycle Progression
verified_invariants.statement: Requirements strictly traverse valid state transitions: DRAFT -> ACTIVE -> SUPERSEDED / CANCELLED.

verified_invariants.name: Epistemic Boundary & Ambiguity Defense
verified_invariants.statement: Natural language requests lacking clear actionable target or criteria trigger CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED without mutating state.

verified_invariants.name: Deterministic Conflict Detection
verified_invariants.statement: Deltas violating immutable constraints (e.g. CST_API_IMMUTABLE) are flagged as CONSTRAINT_CONFLICT and blocked.

verified_invariants.name: Security Sentinel Protection
verified_invariants.statement: Malicious or destructive intents (e.g. disable auth, drop tables, bypass sandbox) are rejected with HTTP 403 / REJECTED.

verified_invariants.name: Economic Invariant Enforcement
verified_invariants.statement: Deltas whose estimated cost exceeds remaining mission budget ceiling are rejected before execution.

verified_invariants.name: Pause-Before-Replan Policy
verified_invariants.statement: Intents classified with STRUCTURAL impact transition mission status to PAUSED prior to DAG mutation.

verified_invariants.name: Optimistic Concurrency Control
verified_invariants.statement: Submissions where base_intent_version != current_intent_version are rejected with STALE status.

verified_invariants.name: Preview Side-Effect Freedom
verified_invariants.statement: preview_intent_delta produces complete impact, conflict, and diff analyses without mutating engine state.

verified_invariants.name: Causal Explainability in Why Panel
verified_invariants.statement: All replanned and compensation tasks maintain an explicit causal link to the triggering delta_id and intent_version.

verified_invariants.name: Zero Simulated Metrics Mandate
verified_invariants.statement: All metrics, durations, and QA screenshots stem from live runtime execution and real Microsoft Edge interaction.
